name: Calm Cards
description: A quiet deck of short cards, read one at a time. Install a card pack to fill it. Your place is saved, so you can stop whenever you like.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A deck of short cards shown one at a time. The cards come from a card pack.
help.goal: There is nothing to win. Read at your own pace and stop whenever you like.
howToPlay: Read the card in front of you.
Press Show more to see the rest of the card, if it has more.
Press Next for the following card, or Previous to go back.
At the end of the deck you can start again.

controls.action: Previous or next card, when the card is focused
Reach Show more, Previous and Next

tips: Your place is saved, so a break can be as short as one card.
